On ALERT (a kill-switch breach, an orphan, a dead connector, a missed step) it posts in the room, tags Demo Risk Manager (who decides STOP) and Chief of Staff (who escalates to Ofer). It never repeats the same alert inside 2 hours unless it gets worse. Code does all math; the model writes only short prose.
